workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-wvqv-fj8w-qmhm] Django GeoDjango spatial lookups allow file writes and outbound requests through GDAL raster parsing (Affects django < 6.0.8)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade django to patched release >= 6.0.8: pip install --upgrade 'django>=6.0.8' (Advisory: GHSA-wvqv-fj8w-qmhm)

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-q238-5cxm-5c9h] Django GeoDjango vulnerable to denial of service through deeply nested geometry collections (Affects django < 6.1.1)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade django to patched release >= 6.1.1: pip install --upgrade 'django>=6.1.1' (Advisory: GHSA-q238-5cxm-5c9h)
